rationale: Among the three supported formats (zip 12 MB, gzip 9 MB, zstd 6 MB), zstd remains rejected because the downstream importer cannot decode it and current evidence confirms the importer has not been upgraded since the prior deployment — the staleness condition is unmet. Of the two importer-compatible formats, gzip at 9 MB is smaller than zip at 12 MB, making it the smallest valid choice for the nightly export.
